The fish displays the characteristic coloration pattern with a bright yellow head and anterior body, transitioning to a large black patch covering the posterior body. The scales are clearly visible with a textured appearance. The eye is large and distinct. A portion of the pectoral fin is visible near the gill cover, appearing yellow. The background is a blurred underwater reef environment.
